usage: Readable record of experiment.py constants and neural defaults; CLI currently does not accept --config. Actual outputs/protocol.json and frozen assets are authoritative for the completed run.
fresh_run: pass --output outputs/new_run to every experiment/resources/refine stage, and --root outputs/new_run to report; do not edit sealed code; run_id is output directory name

upstream.reuse: real upstream model classes and training steps; no archived code or old weights restored

rules.action: one finite nonnegative alpha before each slot; bid=alpha*pvalue
rules.auction: single-slot second price, exclude unaffordable winner and reauction

data.scope: all requests in 2 train / 1 validation / 1 test complete 72-slot periods; remaining source periods not evaluated
data.test_read_gate: frozen checkpoint and opponent/table hashes verified before first test cache request

opponents.mixed: 23 Fixed and 24 PID opponents; seeded per day/target, fixed for the entire cycle

target_policies.scope: shared across all roles and three scenarios; no test-specific retraining
target_policies.classical_shared_alpha: median of the frozen per-player Fixed opponent alphas
target_policies.online_lp_lower_boundary_refinement: if minimum wins, validate current_low/4 and current_low/2 on same validation cells; at most 3 rounds, before freeze/test; exact candidates recorded in classical_search.json
unsupported: original quadratic Abid under fixed scalar action
MBRL-MOPO missing training implementation and weights
MBRL-COMBOMICRO missing training implementation and weights

training.seed_selection: all seeds retained; select shared hyperparameters and checkpoint step by mean validation performance, never select best seed
training.collection: target only; all 48 roles * 2 train days * 3 scenarios; each episode exactly 72 transitions
training.behavior_multiplier_semantics: multiply the selected policy multiplier, do not replace it
training.ordering: numeric task index, player id, time slot before NPZ serialization
training.reward_scale: 75th percentile of training episode returns, fallback 1 if zero

cql_extra_stability_configuration.reason: formal validation overflow in an original log-action candidate
cql_extra_stability_configuration.budget: two extra training runs and four checkpoint records; CQL search budget is larger

training.bcq_action_support: max(1,1.25*max(encoded_train_action)); algorithm-specific, not a global rule
training.dt_desired_return: 90th percentile of scaled training episode returns
training.claim: bounded search with transparent extra CQL stability tuning; not proof of convergence

validation.objective: mean role-relative won value across three scenarios
validation.classical_reference: LocalPID multiplier=1 candidate during classical tuning
validation.missing_training_seed: exclude incomplete candidate and record reason
validation.failures: full episode exception or timeout recorded without scores; incomplete paired-seed group excluded

test.rotation: one target player per complete game, all other players are frozen opponent definitions
test.aggregation: mean day/evaluation-seed/training-seed within role, ratio to same-role LocalPID, then equal role mean
test.zero_reference: undefined ratio recorded separately with valid sample counts, no epsilon
test.failure_policy: keep frozen checkpoints; preserve successful raw cases, quarantine incomplete algorithm from main rankings, continue other algorithms; no zero score or test-driven fallback
test.resource_benchmark: same 12 full training episodes, worker counts 1/4/12; selected 4 from actual measured throughput and process RSS
test.inference_timing_scope: target original bidding/update calls only; exclude diagnostic I/O, alpha validation and settlement

overwrite_policy: fresh outputs only; no stale successful result reuse
